events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost him, Tupac Shakur's music and powerful lyrics continue to resonate. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: Still influencing guitarists today, Jimi Hendrix's revolutionary sound changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: That iconic album cover, those timeless tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in '69. Which side are you playing first?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Still bringing the attitude and the anthems. Happy 54th birthday to Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis singalong?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since its release, John Lennon's 'Imagine' remains a powerful message that still resonates today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod's Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod to the world on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched a device that changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy film series.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 and all his adventures. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring musical legacy of John Lennon. What's your most loved Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us some of the most iconic comedy moments. Happy 87th birthday to a true British legend!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, often known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: An experimental masterpiece packed with classics. The Beatles' 'White Album' was released on this day in '68. Which track is your hidden gem?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away.

angles.name: Freddie's Voice
angles.copy: A voice and stage presence unmatched. Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Impact
angles.copy: The album that changed everything for The Beatles, 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in '65. Which track showcases their evolving sound best?
